business.summary: India's largest EMS company; mobile phones dominate. Q2 FY27 revenue ₹21,794 Cr: Mobile & EMS ₹20,093 Cr (op. profit ₹509 Cr), Consumer Electronics ₹1,115 Cr, Home Appliances ₹586 Cr (Q2 FY27 concall). Strategy is backward integration into components (Q Tech camera modules, HKC display JV, Gemtek optical JV) plus a Vivo manufacturing JV to lift volumes and the ~3% margin.

segments.name: Mobile & other EMS (incl. telecom, IT hardware)

promises.promise: Sequential volume/revenue growth of at least 12-15% into FY27 after a flat Q4.
promises.delivered: Revenue ₹10,511 → ₹15,548 Cr (+48% QoQ) in Q1 FY27; mgmt said volumes beat guidance (Q1 FY27 concall).
Revenue ₹21,794 Cr, +40% QoQ — but mgmt attributes mobile/IT growth largely to higher selling prices from memory inflation (Q2 FY27 concall).

promises.promise: Margin profile to stabilise and then improve; exit better as components come in.
promises.delivered: OPM 3.9% (Q4 FY26) → 3.0% (Q1 FY27) → 2.7% (Q2 FY27); washing machine margin compressed to 8.6% from 10.5-11%.

promises.promise: Vivo JV transaction to be concluded within the next two months.
promises.delivered: At Q2 FY27, commercials 'still being finalized'; consolidation now expected from Q4 FY27.

promises.promise: Display modules with HKC to start from end-Q3 / beginning-Q4 FY27.
promises.delivered: Q2 FY27: auto/notebook trials in Q3, mobile display trials in Q4, mass production 'from next fiscal' — slipped to FY28.

promises.promise: FY27 smartphone volumes 33-34M ex-Vivo; 55-60M including Vivo; exports 3.5-4M.
promises.delivered: Not yet testable; Vivo consolidation only from Q4.

promises.promise: Display + camera modules to add 80-100 bps to margin over 2 years; display ₹6,000-7,000 Cr revenue potential on ~₹1,000 Cr capex.
promises.delivered: Display not yet in production; Q Tech H1 FY27 revenue flat YoY and its margin fell ~450 bps in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Strong volume momentum and order book drive growth (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue +47% YoY in Q2 FY27, but mgmt concedes the mobile/IT growth is 'basically because the selling prices have gone up' on memory costs.
OPM drifted 3.8-3.9% (FY26) → 2.7% (Q2 FY27); component revenue still minimal; Q Tech margin down ~450 bps in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Reported profit is lumpy due to a non-operating gain.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Other income ₹497 Cr (Q2 FY26) and ₹537 Cr (Q1 FY27) vs ₹72 Cr (Q2 FY27) — fair-value gains on the Aditya Infotech stake; ex-gain Q2 FY27 EBITDA ₹609 Cr, PAT ₹293 Cr.

guidance.guide: Consolidation from Q4 FY27; ~20-21M units/yr; capex ₹300-350 Cr
Trials Q3/Q4 FY27, mass production FY28; ~₹1,000 Cr capex; 25-30% of ₹7,000 Cr potential in FY28
+80-100 bps over 2 years from display + camera modules

bull: Revenue ₹21,794 Cr in Q2 FY27, +47% YoY, beating the 20-25% QoQ guide (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls; results).
Vivo JV adds ~20M units/yr from Q4 FY27, taking volumes toward 55-60M (Q2 FY27 concall).
Component play (display, camera, optical JV) targets +80-100 bps margin in 2 years (Q2 FY27 concall).
bear: Margins going the wrong way: OPM 3.9% → 2.7% despite the 'stabilise and improve' promise (Q1 FY27 concall; results).
Execution timelines slip: Vivo close (promised ~Sep-26) and display start (promised Q3/Q4) both pushed out (Q1, Q4 FY26, Q2 FY27 concalls).
Growth is partly price, not volume — memory inflation inflates revenue (Q2 FY27 concall).
